versions.content: Naming convention for Scheduled functions Scheduled functions of a BSW Module shall be named according to the following: <Mip>_MainFunction[_<Sd>] Wh ere <Mip> is the Module implementation prefix ( SWS_BSW_00102 ) . The content between brackets shall be used only if the module defines more than one Scheduled function, where <Sd> is a module specific name extension given to every function.
